purpose: Attempt to falsify residual novelty of T-11 by finding prior explicit NP/coNP classifications of unrestricted Boolean-circuit functional dependency or its two-copy bad-fiber decision problem.

claim_under_test.residual_only: Given succinct Boolean circuits for a target f and observation/base functions G, existence of two inputs with equal G-values and unequal f-values is NP-complete; exact factorization f=h(G) is coNP-complete.

queries: functional decomposition NP complete Boolean circuit
functional decomposition coNP complete Boolean circuit
full_text_policy: Retrieve only a candidate whose title or abstract materially indicates an explicit complexity classification; prefer open or author-hosted copies; record closed sources honestly.

include_if: title or abstract discusses computational complexity of Boolean functional dependency/decomposition/determination
title or abstract states NP-hard, NP-complete, coNP-hard, or coNP-complete for an equivalent circuit decision problem
paper gives a general complexity classification whose theorem appears applicable to T-11
exclude_if: functional dependency means relational database dependencies without a circuit/function equivalence
paper merely uses SAT operationally without classifying the decision problem
decomposition concerns numerical optimization, matrices, molecules, or unrelated domains
complexity statement concerns only minimizing decomposition size rather than existence of factorization

falsifier: A pre-existing result explicitly proves NP-hardness/NP-completeness of the bad-fiber witness problem or coNP-hardness/coNP-completeness of unrestricted Boolean-circuit functional dependency, under a polynomially equivalent input representation.
non_falsifiers: a SAT encoding without a hardness proof
NP-hardness of finding an optimal or minimum decomposition
complexity under restrictions not shown equivalent to unrestricted T-11
stop_conditions: Do not follow references or cited-by edges.
Do not add candidates to the active ten-record seed corpus.
Do not claim novelty from a null result.
If a direct prior classification is found, record T-11 as falsified and stop broadening queries.

execution_gate.scope: Eight frozen OpenAlex searches, at most 80 candidates, followed by screening and only decisive targeted full-text retrieval; no reference expansion.
execution_gate.candidate_ledger_redaction: Public URL values are replaced by sha256:<digest>; bibliographic content, DOI, provider IDs, abstracts, and query provenance are retained.
